title: How to find expressible and trainable parameterized quantum circuits?
abstract: arXiv:2603.14451v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Whether parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) can be systematically constructed to be both trainable and expressive remains an open question. Highly expressive PQCs often exhibit barren plateaus, while several trainable alternatives admit efficient classical simulation. We prove that deciding whether a PQC family exhibits a barren plateau is undecidable in general. However, we derive a practical finite-sample, dimension-independent concentration bound for estimating the variance of a PQC cost function, yielding explicit trainability guarantees. Across commonly used ans\"atze, we observe an anticorrelation between trainability and expressibility, consistent with theoretical insights. Building on this observation, we propose a property-based ansatz-search framework for identifying circuits that combine trainability and expressibility. translated_title: 如何找到既具表达能力又可训练的参数化量子电路？
translated_abstract: 参数化量子电路（PQCs）能否被系统地构建为既可训练又具表达能力，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。高表达能力的PQC往往会出现贫瘠高原现象，而一些可训练的替代方案则可以被经典计算机高效模拟。我们证明，判定一个PQC族是否表现出贫瘠高原在一般情况下是不可判定的。然而，我们推导出了一个实用的、有限样本且与维度无关的集中不等式界，用于估计PQC成本函数的方差，从而给出明确的可训练性保证。在常用的拟设（ansätze）中，我们观察到可训练性与表达能力之间存在反相关关系，这与理论见解相一致。基于这一观察，我们提出了一个基于属性的拟设搜索框架，用于识别兼具可训练性和表达能力的电路。我们在真实的量子计算机上演示了该框架的实际可行性，并将其应用于变分量子算法。
tldr: 该论文证明判定参数化量子电路是否存在贫瘠高原一般是不可判定的，但推导出有限样本、维度无关的成本函数方差集中界以提供可训练性保证，并基于可训练性与表达能力之间的反相关关系，提出了一个在真实量子设备上可行的基于属性的拟设搜索框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that deciding whether a PQC family exhibits barren plateaus is generally undecidable, derives a practical finite-sample, dimension-independent concentration bound yielding explicit trainability guarantees, and proposes a property-based ansatz-search framework, validated on real quantum hardware, to find circuits combining trainability and expressibility.
